name: Union Consumer Square
summary: Union Consumer Square is a popular strip mall in Cheektowaga featuring big-box stores and restaurants with ample parking. The center serves as a convenient shopping destination for local residents seeking everyday retail and dining options.
demographics: Union Consumer Square serves a middle-income, family-oriented demographic in the Cheektowaga area, drawing primarily from suburban households within a 3-5 mile radius. The trade area consists of working and middle-class families seeking convenient access to big-box retailers and everyday shopping needs. Typical visitors are value-conscious shoppers aged 25-65 who prioritize one-stop shopping convenience and ample parking for their household errands and purchases.
description: Union Consumer Square is a well-established strip mall located on Union Road in Cheektowaga, New York, serving as a convenient shopping destination for the local community. The center features big-box retailers and a selection of restaurants that cater to everyday shopping and dining needs. With a spacious parking lot that can accommodate high traffic volumes, the property offers easy access and convenience for busy families and working professionals. The center has earned a solid reputation among locals, reflected in its 4.2-star rating from nearly 1,900 reviews, demonstrating consistent community engagement and satisfaction. Union Consumer Square's strategic location on Union Road positions it as an accessible retail hub for the greater Cheektowaga area, providing essential services and shopping options in a practical, open-air format.
